description: A committed, permanent local example of the ai-3d-factory workflow: a rectangular mounting plate with rounded corners and 4 corner mounting holes. Demonstrates a hand-authored OpenSCAD part (mirroring the parameter names of `factory generate-cadquery --template mechanical-plate`, factory/cad/cadquery_backend.py) since CadQuery is an optional dependency not installed in this environment - see cad/mechanical_plate.scad and docs/cad-backends.md. This is a demo/reference project living under examples/, not a real order - see examples/mechanical-plate/README.md.
constraints: Original design only - generic mounting plate, not a reproduction of any manufacturer part.
Demo scale only (80mm x 50mm x 5mm, 4mm corner mounting holes) - not measured against any real hardware or mounting pattern.
This is a workflow example, not a print order: no STL has been exported, and this example is not slicer_review_ready, human_approved, or print_ready.
